determinism-intro.title: What deterministic simulation actually means
determinism-intro.description: Same seed, same inputs, same bytes out. Fifteen minutes on the three things you have to give up to get there: the wall clock, ambient randomness, and unordered iteration. Background reading: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deterministic_simulation

comments.author: praman
comments.text: The bit about HashMap iteration order at 4:10 is the one people always miss.

comments.author: carol
comments.text: Sending this to every new hire from now on.

flaky-test-windows.title: Debugging a test that only fails on Windows
flaky-test-windows.description: A BFS path test that passes everywhere except one CI runner. We read the failure, find the hash-order bug, and fix it in nine lines. Issue: http://github.com/northstar/atlas/issues/14  Question: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/4411  Write-up: http://bmartinez.net/posts/hash-order-bit-me

comments.author: bob
comments.text: I lived this. The write-up in the description is mine, ask me anything.

carol-postmortem.title: Release postmortem: twelve minutes of elevated latency
carol-postmortem.description: What INC-4 looked like from the release chair, why the rollback was boring, and the three checklist lines we added afterwards. Status page: http://status.northstar.example/

comments.author: admin
comments.text: Correction at 9:40 — the alert fired at minute two, not minute four.

atlas-walkthrough.title: Atlas 1.0 walkthrough — deterministic simulation end to end
atlas-walkthrough.description: A full run of Atlas from seed to replay: processes, filesystem, network and browser, all reproducible byte for byte. Repo: http://github.com/northstar/atlas  Post: http://eng.northstar.example/posts/shipping-atlas  Coverage: http://theverge.com/2026/atlas-determinism

comments.author: bob
comments.text: The BFS bit at 6:20 finally made it click.

comments.author: praman
comments.text: Replay from a checkpoint at 9:55 is the part I would lead with next time.

comments.author: carol
comments.text: Two years of arguing about this in one video. Nice work.
